subject: Mobile data gone?
body: Hey team, our mobile dashboards have been flat since Tuesday. Web looks fine. Did something change on your side?

subject: new-checkout flag not showing for anyone
body: We set new-checkout to 100% for our staff but none of us get it. Flag is enabled. What are we missing?

subject: Unique users way too high
body: PostHog says we had thousands of unique users this week. We have about 60 real customers logging in. Something is off.

subject: Error spike after release
body: We shipped 2.4.0 yesterday and error tracking lit up. Is this a PostHog issue or ours?

subject: Can't filter pageviews by URL
body: A chunk of our pageviews have a blank URL so they vanish when we filter by page. Not sure where they come from.
